messages:
samir: Quick q — customer ACME-42 asked for full data deletion (logs, traces, caches). What is the minimal safe path to satisfy request + audit? cc @marta @alyssa

marta: Lifecycle rules don't count as fulfilling a deletion request. We need explicit removal from S3 prefixes + search/indexes + any caches. Also update the deletion audit record.

alyssa: Confirming legal reviewed the request earlier today (ticket DEL-1234). We can proceed once infra confirms steps + an approver.

jamie: Who can actually run the deletes? infra-admins only? We should avoid giving blanket perms.

marta: Only infra-admins or the oncall runbook role can perform irreversible deletes. Preferred flow: 1) snapshot indices, 2) run deletion commands, 3) append audit entry, 4) request verifier signoff.

samir: Can you paste the exact commands we should use? want to prep CI job.

marta: Example commands (one-off, run from bastion with infra-admin creds):
```
# S3 logs
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-logs/customers/ACME-42 --recursive
# ES delete by query (replace ES_HOST)
curl -s -XPOST "https://ES_HOST/_delete_by_query" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":{"term":{"customer_id":"ACME-42"}}}'
# Redis cache keys
redis-cli -h redis-host --scan --pattern "cust:ACME-42:*" | xargs -r redis-cli -h redis-host del
```

alyssa: Add note: create a snapshot before delete: `snap create es ACME-42-pre-delete-$(date +%s)` and store snapshot id in DEL-1234. Legal wants retention of the audit, not data.

jamie: For S3 we should use `--dryrun` first then actual rm. Also add a lifecycle check: some buckets have versioning -> need to purge versions.

marta: Good call. For versioned buckets: `aws s3api delete-objects` with version ids. Infra runbook has a helper script `tools/purge_customer.sh` that handles versions + multipart. Use that if available.

infra-bot: Runbook trigger: delete_customer_data v2 requested by samir. Please attach ticket DEL-1234 and request approver (security@redwood).

samir: I'll attach DEL-1234 now. Who signs off for infra? @marta?

marta: I can review and approve once snapshot confirms. I'll also update retention.md with the exact steps and add a short note about redaction vs deletion (logs with PII need removal, metadata audit preserved).

alyssa: After deletion, we need to mark customer as deleted in CRM and trigger any downstream syncs so no replay re-ingest.

jamie: Quick perms note: after this, let's add a short SOP to restrict who can run `purge_customer.sh` (AWS IAM + vault role). I'll open an infra PR.

samir: Thanks — I'll prepare a dry-run today and report back here with snapshot id + time.

marta: Awesome. If anyone needs the exact helper script path: `/opt/infra/tools/purge_customer.sh`. Ping me when ready and I'll do final approval. :thumbsup:
